def transform(grid):
    # Each cell of the encoded output is carried by the color at a junction
    # in the repeated separator lattice. Separator spacing is tile size + 1.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # identify periods from repeated row/column patterns
    def period_rows():
        for d in range(1,h):
            if all(grid[r] == grid[r % d] for r in range(h)):
                return d
        return h
    # Here lattice boundaries are every 8-ish rows and 4-ish columns; in these
    # ARC inputs periods are the dimensions of each repeated patch.
    rh = next((d for d in range(2,h) if all(grid[r] == grid[r % d] for r in range(h))), None)
    if rh is None: rh = 8
    # Sample marker at first row of each tile and column boundary points.
    # Grid patterns have uniform fill between marker-bearing border rows.
    # Derive boundary positions as rows with >1 distinct values.
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) > 1]
    # Regular horizontal boundary interval from earliest repeated pattern.
    rstep = min((b-a for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]) if b-a>1), default=1)
    # More reliably, separator rows are the sparse horizontal rows (non-fill color).
    base = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row))
    rsep=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(x!=base for x in row) < len(row)//2]
    rstep = min((b-a for a,b in zip(rsep,rsep[1:])), default=1)
    csep=[c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c]!=base for r in range(h)) < h//2]
    cstep=min((b-a for a,b in zip(csep,csep[1:])), default=1)
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in csep[::cstep]] for r in rsep[::rstep]]

    # separator crossings of the repeated tiled background.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # separator rows are the only rows with mostly the border color and
    # separator columns are the corresponding repeated lanes
    sep_color = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # In this construction horizontal separators occur every 8 rows and
    # vertical marker lanes at the ends of 3-wide tiles.
    row_step = 8

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    markers = {r: row[0] for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0}
    period = len(markers)
    colors = {r % period: color for r, color in markers.items()}
    return [[colors[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The grid is a 5-by-3 arrangement of rooms divided by complete
    # rows/columns of color 9. Mark a room 1 when it contains at least
    # two cells of color 4; otherwise mark it with its background color 8.
    sep = 9
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + hr + [h], [-1] + vc + [w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
                     for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])]
            row.append(1 if cells.count(4) >= 2 else 8)
        out.append(row)
    return out
